name: US NCS-style project standard (architecture and interiors, imperial)
description: A starting project standard in the style of the US National CAD Standard: AIA-style delimited layer names, Uniform Drawing System sheet identifiers, imperial scales and plotted text heights. Built from public owner standards that republish NCS codes; it is not the licensed NCS text.
jurisdiction: United States (style preset; not a code or a licensed standard)
notes: STATUS: style preset. The licensed NCS v7 (AIA CAD Layer Guidelines, UDS, Plotting Guidelines) is paywalled [S07]; nothing here is presented as its official content. Code lists come from public derivatives: City of Calgary [S01][S02][S04], State of Missouri FMDC [S09], Illinois State University [S10], Draftsperson.net [S05], Archtoolbox [S06][S11], NY State OGS [S22], AUGI [S48]. Source ids resolve in references/practice/_SOURCES.md and research/05-expert-practice-and-standards.md.

LAYER FORMAT [S05][S01][S02]: discipline designator (1 character plus an optional 1-character modifier), major group (4), up to two minor groups (4 each), optional 1-character status written last; hyphen separated. The second designator character is a modifier, written without a hyphen (AD-WALL).

CODE LIST COMPLETENESS: codeLists.disciplines is COMPLETE as published by Calgary [S01] (NCS-derived, level 1). codeLists.disciplineModifiers is PARTIAL: only modifiers seen in public examples [S06]; the full level-2 list was not found publicly. layerNaming.majorGroup is COMPLETE for the Calgary derivative [S02] plus the Missouri codes it lacks [S09]; it is NOT identical to NCS (Calgary writes SPKL where NCS writes SPRN, for example). layerNaming.minorGroup is PARTIAL: codes seen in public examples [S05][S09]; Calgary publishes several hundred more [S03]; allowOther is true because NCS-derived standards allow documented user-defined 4-character minor groups [S02][S03]. layerNaming.status is COMPLETE per [S05] (not checked against licensed NCS v7 text). codeLists.sheetTypes is COMPLETE [S04][S06]. codeLists.setOrder is COMPLETE per [S06].

TILDE PADDING: NCS-derived standards pad short user-defined minor groups with '~' [S02][S03]. The engine's US scheme accepts '~' only inside listed codes (AIR~, GAS~, OIL~ are listed major groups); a padded user-defined minor group is reported as not alphanumeric. Add it to minorGroup.codes if the project uses one.

OWNER VARIANTS: Missouri sets sheet type 7 = reflected ceiling plans [S09]; NY OGS uses its own type digits and a discipline-type-floor-sector pattern [S22]; older owner standards put status in a 4-character minor group (NEWW, EXST, DEMO...) [S09], which the minor group list accepts. Override in the project copy.

SENSIBLE DEFAULTS, NOT SOURCED (a project should override them): the starter layer list (which layers, their descriptions), every layer colour, linetype and lineweight, the text style and dimension style names and settings, the title block field names, statusCodes (issue descriptions), revisionCodes, the patterns, codeLists.xrefLayers beyond G-ANNO-REFR, and codeLists.approvedFonts beyond Arial. Starter layer colours were chosen so that a layer's lineweight equals the plotted width Missouri's colour-dependent pen table gives its colour (1 .008 in, 2 .006, 3 .004, 4 .002, 5 .010, 6 .016, 7 .012, 8 .020 in) [S09], rounded to the nearest AutoCAD lineweight; plotting by CTB or by layer lineweight then gives the same weight. The assignment of colours to layers is a default.

PLOTTED TEXT HEIGHTS: 3/32 in for notes, dimensions and labels and 1/8 in for tags [S10][S22]; view titles 3/16 in is a default inside the 3/16-5/16 in range [S10]; 5/16 in titles and 3/8, 1/2, 1 in sheet numbers on ARCH C, D, E [S10]. Model height = plotted height x scale factor: 3/32 in at 1/4" = 1'-0" (factor 48) is 4.5 in [S10].
SCALES: factors and model text heights per the Illinois State scaling chart [S10]; 1/32" = 1'-0" from [S11]. 1:1 is listed for full-size details.

DIMENSIONS: architectural units, 1/4 in display precision. AIA guidance: round to the nearest 1/2 in, occasionally 1/4 in, never finer [S49]; AUGI rounds to 1/4 in [S48]. Set DIMRND 0.5 in the project copy for 1/2 in rounding. Draw at 1:1, one unit = one inch, DIMSCALE from the Fit tab (or annotative) [S10]. Settings other than DIMLUNIT, DIMDEC and DIMTXT are defaults.

LINETYPE SCALE: use one method per project (cad-standards.md section 6): Illinois State LTSCALE = half the scale factor with PSLTSCALE 0 [S10], or PSLTSCALE 1, MSLTSCALE 1, LTSCALE 1 (typical practice). The shipped checks expect PSLTSCALE 1 and MSLTSCALE 1; change them in the project's checks copy for the other method.

SHEET SIZES: codeLists.sheetSizes lists ARCH and ANSI sizes in inches (width x height) [S81, search excerpt only][S10 for ARCH C, D, E, E1]. The schema has no numeric sheet size member, so the size is in each code's name.
FILE NAMING: no public US file naming standard was sourced, so this preset has no fileNaming rule. Add the project's rule.

LAYER ROLES, VIEW NAMES, PURGE AND TITLE BLOCK: layerRoles names the layer for viewport frames, xref inserts and the title block insert; viewNaming is the view name rule (the same default as patterns.viewName); purge.keep lists names a purge must keep beyond what the standard already lists, and is empty here; titleBlock.blockName and titleBlock.familyType are not set, because the title block is the project's own. All four are DEFAULTS, not sourced: a project sets its own.

textStyles.name: TAGS
textStyles.use: Room names and tags: 1/8 in plotted [S22]

dimStyles.name: ARCH-ANNO
dimStyles.description: Annotative architectural dimensions: feet and inches, 1/4 in precision, ticks, text above the line. DIMLUNIT, DIMDEC per [S49][S48]; DIMTXT 3/32 in [S10]; other values are defaults.

sheetNumbering.description: Uniform Drawing System sheet identifier [S06]: discipline letter, a second designator position (modifier letter, or a hyphen when empty), sheet type digit, two-digit sequence: A-101, AD101, I-201. Gaps in the sequence are allowed; sheets run general to specific within a discipline [S06].

fields.name: modifier
fields.description: Modifier letter, or '-' when there is none

viewNaming.description: A capital letter or digit, then letters, digits, spaces, brackets, '&' and '-'. A default, not sourced; NY OGS names views LEVEL DISCIPLINE [DEMO] VIEWTYPE [S22].

revisionCodes.description: Default: revisions numbered 1, 2, 3 with a delta tag on clouds; Revit numbering per sheet or per project is decided before any revision is entered [S67][S22]. Not sourced as a code format.

formats.name: numbered
formats.description: Revision number in the delta tag
